'''Adapted Manducaters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns after a [[Primitive Manducater]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with a spawnweight of 15.
* Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Manducaters are High damage Stealth units and Melee Combatants.

* Adapted Manducaters' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* They can become almost completely invisible, while being in this state, their speed will be greatly slowed down but their damage will be multiplied by 4 and thy will stun the mob they hit. The Invisibility is removed if Adapted Manducaters attacks or are attacked. Adapted Manducaters need 40% of their own HP, and have a 7 seconds cooldown.
* Adapted Manducaters can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Adapted Manducaters can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Like other Adapted land Parasites, Adapted Manducaters can vomit [[Residue]] in a 5x5 area every so often.
* Adapted Manducaters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 40 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherAdaManducater.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Adapted Manducaters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Adapted Manducaters have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Manducaters will become [[Primitive Manducater|Primitive Manducaters]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Adapted Manducaters are also known as '''Hull''' in the Mod Files.
* Adapted Manducaters were considered by Dhanantry as the hardest Mob to balance, basing on the first QnA Event Answers.
* In-game text is inconsistent with the spelling of its name, with items calling it "Manducater" with an E, and the subtitles calling it "Manducator" with an O.
